name: Kami ni Aisareta Hanayome ~Mayonaka no Chigiri~
original_name: 神に愛された花嫁～真夜中の契り～
source: You arrive into a godless village full of handsome men to take a marriage interview. However, these men are surrounded by mysteries, which will only get bigger when you choose to marry one of them...
translation: 你来到一个充满英俊男子的无神村庄去参加婚姻面试。然而，这些男人都充满了谜团，当你选择嫁给他们中的一个时，谜团只会变得更大……
